latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — instantly create social-media-ready videos from your images, no video editing skills required.

- Upload still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, up to 200MB) and convert them into smooth animated video clips via cloud AI.
- Fully automatic setup: detects or generates API tokens and manages user sessions for you.
- Simple text prompts control the workflow — ask for 15-second videos, smooth transitions, aspect ratio, background music, or text overlays.
- Download finished videos in 1080p MP4 format, ready for social sharing.
- Covers error handling for uploads, token/credit management, and guides users through common issues.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline (typically completes in 30–60 seconds per video).
